destination.name: Melbourne
destination.tagline: Australia's cultural capital, with Victorian architecture, galleries and trams
destination.description: Melbourne, known as Naarm in Woiworrung, is Australia's second-biggest city, home to about 5.4 million people. It is noted for Victorian-era architecture, museums, galleries, theatres, parks and gardens, and for a strong food, wine and coffee culture and live music scene. Australian rules football was invented here, and the World Heritage-listed Royal Exhibition Building and the Melbourne Cricket Ground are landmarks. It is also the usual base for the Great Ocean Road, the Grampians and Phillip Island's penguin parade.
whyVisit: Wander laneways for street art and coffee
Eat through the city's migrant cuisines

goodToKnow.title: Free Tram Zone
goodToKnow.detail: Trams in the CBD Free Tram Zone cost nothing and need no touch-on. Touching on inside it charges a full fare.

goodToKnow.title: Pack for any weather
goodToKnow.detail: The weather can swing through four seasons in a day, so carry a layer and a rain jacket even in summer.

goodToKnow.title: Get a myki card
goodToKnow.detail: Trains, trams and buses use the myki card (adult card $6). Daily fares are capped, at $11.00 on weekdays as of Mar 2025.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} brings mild days for exploring on foot. Summer can be hot and winters cool and damp.
